tei:div.tei:p: dag snang las zab gter chos sgo 'byed pa'i gsol 'debs thugs dam gnad bskul bzhugs so: dgongs shig skyabs gnas mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: gson cig ma gcig mtsho rgyal ma: mgon med bdag la thugs rjes gzigs: dus ngan snyigs ma'i yang mtha' 'dir: chos sgrub bu dman rgyal bstan nyams: 'gro kun log lam bdud kyis bslus: gsang sngags chos la skur pa btab: log lta'i 'dam tshud mi dge bsags: pad 'byung sprul pas gdul dka' 'byung: 'gro ba'i log sgrub dbang gis ni: zab gter sgo 'byed gsang ba'i grogs: gzhan gyi dbang du 'gyur srid pas: ma rnams thugs dam dbyings nas bzhengs: thugs rje mthu dpung rab bskyed nas: tshe rabs gtan gyi gsang ba'i grogs: rten 'brel legs bsgrigs bdag la dbang: sngon gyi smon lam mthu stobs kyis: khab len rdo yis lcags blang bzhin: blo yid sems gsum dbang du bsdus: 'bral mi phod pa'i dad pa yis: gsang sngags rim bzhin nyams su blang: 36)gu ru pad 'byung yab yum gyis: gsang gsum byin rlabs bdag smin mdzod: rim gnyis mthar phyin bstan 'gro'i don: gsang mdzod zab mo'i gtad rgya khrol: zab gsang chos kyi bstan pa rgyas: thabs shes mdzad pa phrin las kun: yid bzhin nor bu mtsho rgyal gyi: thugs bzhed yongs su 'grub par shog: pad+ma thod phreng bka' dam bzhin: gnas pa'i chos skyong gter bdag rnams: bdag dbang zab gter gnas gang yod: dus babs rten 'brel mi 'dzol bar: bdag gis phrin las bcol bzhin sgrubs: bar chad bdud dpung tshar bcad nas: ga ga'i gdul bya'i zhing du gyur: mdor na chos dang grogs yo byad: chos 'dzin skyes bu la sogs pa: pad 'byung yab yum bka' bsgos bzhin: bdud kyi dbang du mi 'gro zhing: mkha' 'gro chos skyong mthu stobs kyis: rten 'brel yongs su 'grub gyur cig: 37) sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: ces pa'ang rang lo nyer lnga'i dus mkha' 'gro'i 'du tshogs kyi skabs a ma mtsho rgyal gyis bdag la khyod mkha' 'gro'i pho nya yin pas phyir log dang bstan 'gro'i don 'ong gsungs nas chang thod pa gang gnang nas phyag g.yas bdag gi mgor bzhag nas chos dang dam tshig gi zhal ta mang du mdzad:

bdag gis kyang gang dran snyan gsan 'dod don du gsol ba 'di 'dra ba zhig btab nas bdag dang bdag lta bu ma gtogs gzhan su gcig la dgos pa med snyam nas gsang rgya dam po byas yod skabs gsang grogs las 'brel rtsal gyi bka' btsan ldog tu ma spobs par bsdus tsam bris pa'o// shes rab kyis thabs la phul ba dge ka dag spros pa bral ba ya: lhun grub ye shes ma 'gags pa: thugs rje rang gsal mtsho rgyal mar: gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs: shes rab ye shes dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ pad+ma dzñā na ḍā ki ni sā ra dza ya pradzñā sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: su kha badz+ra gyis so// 38)
